name: Spaghetti al pomodoro
description: Gluten-free spaghetti in a quick, glossy garlic and tomato sauce finished with torn basil.
steps: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil.
Warm the olive oil in a wide frying pan over a low heat and add the garlic. Let it sizzle gently for 2 minutes without browning.
Tip in the tomatoes and sugar, season, and simmer for 15 minutes, squashing any lumps, until thick.
Meanwhile cook the spaghetti following the pack timing. Gluten-free pasta goes soft quickly, so start tasting a minute early.
Scoop out a mugful of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti and toss it into the sauce with a splash of the water until glossy.
Tear in the basil and serve with grated cheese if you like.

name: Sunflower seed pesto pasta with green beans
description: A bright, nut-free basil pesto made with toasted sunflower seeds, tossed through pasta, green beans and potatoes.
steps: Toast the sunflower seeds in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden. Let them cool.
Blitz the seeds, basil, garlic, cheese and lemon juice in a food processor, then pour in the olive oil with the motor running. Season.
Boil the potatoes in salted water for 8 minutes, add the pasta, then add the beans for the last 4 minutes.
Save a cup of the cooking water, then drain everything.
Stir the pesto through with a splash of the water until creamy, and serve.

name: Chicken and mushroom risotto
description: Creamy, slow-stirred risotto with golden chicken, mushrooms and a good grating of Parmesan.
steps: Dissolve the stock cubes in the hot water and keep it warm on a low heat.
Brown the chicken in half the oil in a large pan, then lift it out. Fry the mushrooms in the same pan until golden, and lift them out too.
Soften the onion in the rest of the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic and the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until each ladleful is absorbed. This takes about 20 minutes.
When the rice is just tender, stir the chicken and mushrooms back in with the butter and Parmesan. Cover and rest for 2 minutes.
Season and scatter with parsley.

name: Slow-cooker beef ragù
description: Braising beef cooked low and slow in tomato until it falls apart, served over gluten-free pasta.
steps: Brown the beef in batches in the oil in a hot frying pan and put it in the slow cooker.
Fry the onion, carrot and celery in the same pan for 5 minutes, add the garlic and tomato purée for 1 minute, then add to the slow cooker.
Crumble in the stock cube and add the tomatoes, water, herbs and bay leaves. Stir.
Cook on LOW for 8 hours (or HIGH for 5) until the beef falls apart.
Shred the beef with two forks, remove the bay leaves and season.
Cook the pasta, toss with the ragù and serve with Parmesan if you like.

name: Chickpea and spinach curry
description: A mellow, coconut-rich curry from store-cupboard tins, ready in half an hour.
steps: Put the rice on to cook following the pack instructions.
Fry the onion in the oil for 6–8 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Stir in the spices for 30 seconds until fragrant, then add the tomatoes, coconut milk and chickpeas.
Simmer for 15 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts, season with salt, and scatter with coriander. Serve with the rice.

name: Slow-cooker red lentil dal
description: Golden, soothing lentils that cook themselves. Finish with a squeeze of lemon and plenty of coriander.
steps: Put everything except the spinach, lemon, coriander and rice into the slow cooker. Crumble in the stock cube and stir.
Cook on LOW for 6 hours (or HIGH for 3), stirring once if you can, until the lentils have broken down.
Cook the rice shortly before serving.
Stir in the spinach (if using) and the lemon juice, season, and loosen with a little hot water if needed.
Serve over the rice, topped with coriander.

name: Chicken tikka traybake
description: Yogurt-and-spice marinated chicken roasted with cauliflower, peppers and red onion on one tray.
steps: Mix the yogurt, spices, garlic, ginger, half the lemon juice and a good pinch of salt. Coat the chicken and leave for 10 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan).
Toss the cauliflower, peppers and onion with the oil and salt on a large roasting tray.
Sit the chicken on top and roast for 30–35 minutes until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Squeeze over the remaining lemon and scatter with coriander.

name: Air-fryer onion bhajis
description: Crisp, lacy bhajis made with gram flour, which is naturally gluten-free, and cooked with barely any oil.
steps: Toss the onions with the salt and leave for 5 minutes to soften.
Stir in the gram flour, spices, baking powder and coriander, then add the water a little at a time to make a thick, sticky batter that coats the onions.
Heat the air fryer to 190°C. Brush the basket with a little oil.
Drop in spoonfuls of the mixture, flatten slightly and brush the tops with oil.
Cook for 12–15 minutes, turning halfway, until deep golden and crisp. Cook in batches if needed.

name: Egg fried rice with peas
description: Better than a takeaway: day-old rice, fluffy egg, peas and spring onion, seasoned with tamari.

ingredients.note: cooked the day before and chilled

steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok until very hot. Add the garlic and most of the spring onion for 30 seconds.
Add the cold rice and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes, breaking up any clumps, until hot.
Push the rice to one side, pour the eggs into the gap and scramble until just set, then toss them through the rice.
Add the peas and tamari and stir-fry for 2 minutes more.
Finish with the sesame oil and the remaining spring onion.

name: Sweet and sour chicken
description: Crisp-edged chicken and peppers in a tangy pineapple sauce, thickened with cornflour.
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk the ketchup, vinegar, tamari, sugar, 100 ml of the pineapple juice and 1 tbsp of the cornflour to make the sauce.
Toss the chicken in the remaining cornflour with a pinch of salt.
Stir-fry the chicken in 2 tbsp oil in a very hot wok for 5–6 minutes until golden and cooked. Lift it out.
Add the rest of the oil and stir-fry the onion and peppers for 3 minutes, then the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the sauce and pineapple and bubble until glossy and thick, then return the chicken and toss. Serve with the rice.

name: Garlic-ginger tofu and broccoli
description: Crispy cornflour-coated tofu and broccoli in a sticky tamari, garlic and ginger glaze.
steps: Cook the rice. Mix the tamari, maple syrup, vinegar and 3 tbsp water.
Toss the tofu in the cornflour and fry in 2 tbsp oil in a wok, turning, until crisp on all sides (about 8 minutes). Lift out.
Stir-fry the broccoli in the remaining oil with a splash of water for 3 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and chilli for 1 minute.
Pour in the sauce, return the tofu and toss until sticky.
Top with spring onion and sesame seeds and serve with the rice.

name: Slow-cooker chilli con carne
description: A deep, smoky chilli that's even better the next day. Great for the freezer.
steps: Brown the mince well in the oil in a large frying pan, breaking it up, then tip it into the slow cooker.
Soften the onions and peppers in the same pan for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, spices and tomato purée for 1 minute.
Add everything to the slow cooker with the tomatoes and beans. Crumble in the stock cube with 150 ml water and stir.
Cook on LOW for 8 hours (or HIGH for 4–5).
Season, then serve with rice and a spoonful of yogurt.

name: Black bean and sweetcorn quesadillas
description: Crisp corn tortillas filled with spiced black beans, sweetcorn and melted cheddar.
steps: Roughly mash the beans with the spices, half the lime juice and a pinch of salt. Stir in the sweetcorn, onion and coriander.
Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan so they bend without cracking.
Spread the bean mix over 3 tortillas, scatter with cheese and top with the other 3.
Fry each quesadilla in a lightly oiled frying pan for 2–3 minutes per side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with avocado and lime wedges.

name: Huevos rancheros
description: Eggs baked in a smoky tomato and black bean sauce, spooned over warm corn tortillas.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil in a frying pan for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, chilli and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and beans, season, and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Make 4 dips in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5–6 minutes until the whites are set.
Meanwhile, warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Serve the eggs and sauce on the tortillas with avocado, coriander and feta.

name: Thai green chicken curry
description: Fragrant coconut curry with chicken thighs and green beans, finished with lime and basil.
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the chicken and stir to coat.
Pour in the coconut milk with 100 ml water, bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the green beans and pepper for 5 minutes, until just tender.
Season with the fish sauce, sugar and lime juice to taste, then tear in the basil. Serve with the rice.

name: Prawn pad thai
description: Rice noodles stir-fried with prawns, egg and beansprouts in a tamarind, lime and fish sauce dressing. No peanuts.
steps: Soak the noodles in just-boiled water following the pack timing until bendy but still firm, then drain.
Mix the tamarind, fish sauce, sugar, chilli and the juice of half the lime.
Stir-fry the garlic and prawns in the oil in a very hot wok for 2 minutes until pink.
Push them aside and scramble the eggs in the gap, then add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 minutes.
Add the beansprouts and spring onion for 1 minute. Serve with coriander and lime wedges.

name: Thai griddled beef salad
description: Charred steak sliced over crunchy salad and herbs with a hot, sour, salty lime dressing.
steps: Whisk the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chilli to make the dressing.
Rub the steak with the oil and griddle over a very high heat for 2–3 minutes per side for medium-rare. Rest it for 5 minutes.
Toss the lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes, onion and herbs on a platter.
Slice the steak thinly, toss it in half the dressing and pile it on top. Pour over the rest of the dressing.

name: Shepherd's pie
description: Rich lamb mince under a fluffy, cheesy mash topping. Thickened with cornflour, so it's naturally gluten-free.
steps: Brown the lamb in a large pan, then pour off most of the fat.
Add the onion, carrot and celery and cook for 8 minutes. Stir in the garlic and tomato purée for 1 minute.
Add the water, stock cube, tamari and herbs and simmer for 20 minutes. Thicken with the cornflour mixed with a little cold water, then stir in the peas.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes for 15–20 minutes until tender, drain, and mash with the butter, milk and seasoning.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Spoon the lamb into a baking dish, top with the mash, rough it up with a fork and scatter with cheese.
Bake for 25–30 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Leek and potato soup
description: Silky, comforting soup that's blended smooth with a stick blender. Made with a gluten-free stock cube.
steps: Melt the butter in a large pan and gently cook the leeks and onion with a pinch of salt for 10 minutes until soft but not brown.
Add the potatoes, water and stock cube. Simmer for 15–20 minutes until the potatoes are very soft.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender, then stir in the milk.
Season well, swirl in the cream if you like, and serve with gluten-free bread.

name: Apple and cinnamon porridge
description: Creamy microwave porridge made with gluten-free oats, grated apple and cinnamon, topped with seeds.
steps: Mix the oats, milk, apple and cinnamon in a large microwaveable bowl.
Microwave on high for 2 minutes, stir, then cook for another 1½–2 minutes until thick and creamy. Watch it doesn't boil over.
Stand for 1 minute, then divide between bowls and top with maple syrup and seeds.

name: Air-fryer chicken katsu curry
description: Crunchy gluten-free crumbed chicken from the air fryer with a sweet, mild Japanese-style curry sauce.
steps: For the sauce, soften the onion and carrot in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the water, stock cube, honey and tamari and simmer for 15 minutes. Blend smooth, then thicken with the cornflour mixed with a splash of water.
Cook the rice.
Dust the chicken in the flour, dip it in the egg, then press it into the breadcrumbs. Spray or brush with the remaining oil.
Air-fry at 200°C for 12–15 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Slice the chicken and serve over the rice with the sauce poured alongside.

name: Miso-glazed salmon rice bowl
description: Oven-roasted salmon with a sweet-salty miso glaze, served over rice with broccoli and spring onion.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and cook the rice.
Mix the miso, honey, tamari and vinegar and brush it over the salmon on a lined tray.
Roast for 12–15 minutes until the salmon flakes and the glaze is sticky.
Steam or boil the broccoli for 4 minutes.
Pile the rice into bowls with the broccoli and salmon, and scatter with spring onion and sesame seeds.

name: Fluffy American pancakes
description: Thick, buttermilk-style pancakes for lazy weekends, with berries and maple syrup.

ingredients.note: melted, plus extra for the pan

steps: Stir the lemon juice into the milk and leave for 5 minutes to thicken slightly.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in a bowl. Whisk the egg and melted butter into the milk.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and mix until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat with a little butter. Add ladlefuls of batter and cook until bubbles pop on top (about 2 minutes), then flip for 1 minute more.
Serve stacked with berries and maple syrup.

name: Gluten-free fluffy pancakes
description: Thick, fluffy pancakes made with a gluten-free flour blend, with berries and maple syrup.

ingredients.note: skip if your flour blend already contains it
melted, plus extra for the pan

steps: Stir the lemon juice into the milk and leave for 5 minutes to thicken slightly.
Whisk the gluten-free flour, xanthan gum (if using), baking powder, sugar and salt in a bowl. Whisk the egg and melted butter into the milk.

Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and mix until smooth. Leave the batter to rest for 5 minutes; gluten-free flour needs a moment to soak up the liquid. If it's too thick to pour, add a splash more milk.

Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat with a little butter. Add ladlefuls of batter and cook until bubbles appear and the edges look set (about 2–3 minutes), then flip for 1 minute more. Gluten-free batter is more delicate, so keep the pancakes small.
Serve stacked with berries and maple syrup. If anyone else is cooking, use a clean pan and utensils so there's no cross-contamination.

name: Air-fryer BBQ chicken wings
description: Extra-crispy wings (the trick is a little baking powder) tossed in sticky BBQ sauce.
steps: Pat the wings very dry with kitchen paper.
Toss with the baking powder, paprika, garlic granules and salt.
Air-fry at 200°C in a single layer for 22–25 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp and cooked through. Cook in batches if needed.
Warm the BBQ sauce with the honey, toss the hot wings in it, and scatter with spring onion.

name: Baked falafel bowls
description: Herby falafel made in the food processor and baked, served with rice, salad and a lemony tahini drizzle.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and line a tray with baking paper. Cook the rice.
Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, spices and 1 tsp salt in a food processor until finely chopped but not a paste.
Mix in the gram flour and baking powder. Shape into 16 small patties.
Brush with 2 tbsp of the oil and bake for 25 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice and enough water to make a pourable sauce.
Build bowls with rice, salad and falafel, then drizzle with tahini sauce and the rest of the oil.

name: Silky lemon houmous
description: Ultra-smooth houmous blitzed with tahini, garlic and lemon. Serve with veg sticks or gluten-free crackers.
steps: Blitz the tahini and lemon juice in a food processor for 1 minute until pale and thick.
Add the garlic, cumin and a pinch of salt, then the chickpeas, and blend for 2 minutes.
With the motor running, add the ice-cold water a spoonful at a time until very smooth.
Spread into a bowl, drizzle with oil and dust with paprika.

name: Beef bulgogi rice bowl
description: Thin slices of steak in a sweet tamari, garlic and sesame marinade, flash-fried and piled onto rice.
steps: Mix the tamari, sugar, garlic, ginger and sesame oil. Toss the beef in it and leave for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok until smoking and stir-fry the beef in a single layer for 2–3 minutes until caramelised.
Serve on the rice with carrot, cucumber, spring onion, sesame seeds and chilli flakes.

name: Kimchi fried rice with a fried egg
description: Tangy, spicy kimchi fried with leftover rice, then topped with a runny fried egg.

ingredients.note: cooked the day before and chilled

steps: Stir-fry the kimchi and garlic in 1 tbsp oil in a wok for 2 minutes.
Add the rice, kimchi juice, tamari and chilli flakes and stir-fry for 4 minutes until hot and slightly crisp.
Meanwhile fry the eggs in the remaining oil in a separate pan until the whites are crisp but the yolks are runny.
Stir the sesame oil and most of the spring onion into the rice, then top with the eggs, the rest of the spring onion and the sesame seeds.

name: Prawn summer rolls with nuoc cham
description: Fresh rice paper rolls packed with prawns, noodles and herbs, with a zingy lime and fish sauce dip. No peanuts.
steps: Make the dip: stir the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, chilli and garlic with 3 tbsp water until the sugar dissolves.
Poach the prawns in simmering water for 2–3 minutes until pink, then cool and halve them lengthways.
Soak the noodles in just-boiled water following the pack timing, then rinse in cold water.
Dip one rice paper in warm water for 10 seconds and lay it on a damp board.
Lay a row of prawns, then noodles, veg and herbs across the middle. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Repeat.
Serve straight away with the dip.

name: Chicken souvlaki with lemon potatoes and tzatziki
description: Lemony, oregano-marinated chicken skewers grilled until charred, with crispy roast potatoes and cool tzatziki.
steps: Mix the juice of 1 lemon, half the oregano, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp oil and seasoning. Toss the chicken in it and thread it onto skewers.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potatoes with the rest of the oil and oregano, salt and the zest of the other lemon, and roast for 35–40 minutes.
Mix the yogurt, cucumber, mint and remaining garlic for the tzatziki, and season.
Grill the skewers on high for 12–15 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with the potatoes, tomato and onion salad, tzatziki and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Greek yogurt with honey and walnuts
description: Thick yogurt drizzled with honey, toasted walnuts and a pinch of cinnamon. A two-minute pudding or breakfast.
steps: Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes (optional, but it makes them crunchier).
Spoon the yogurt into bowls.
Drizzle with honey and scatter with walnuts, cinnamon and berries.

name: Greek yogurt with honey and toasted seeds
description: Thick yogurt drizzled with honey, crunchy toasted seeds and a pinch of cinnamon. A nut-free two-minute pudding or breakfast.
steps: Toast the seeds in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes, until they start to pop and smell nutty.
Spoon the yogurt into bowls.
Drizzle with honey and scatter with the toasted seeds, cinnamon and berries.

name: Chorizo and chickpea stew
description: A smoky one-pot stew of chorizo, peppers, chickpeas and spinach. Mop it up with gluten-free bread.
steps: Fry the chorizo in a dry pan for 3 minutes until it releases its red oil.
Add the onion and peppers and cook for 8 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes, water and crumbled stock cube and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Scatter with parsley and serve with bread.

name: Spanish potato tortilla
description: A thick, golden omelette of slowly cooked potatoes and onions. Good hot, cold, or in a lunchbox.
steps: Cook the potatoes and onion gently in the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan, covered, for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until very soft but not brown.
Beat the eggs with salt in a large bowl. Tip in the potatoes, leaving most of the oil behind, and stand for 5 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in the pan, pour in the mixture and cook on a low heat for 8 minutes until almost set.
Put a large plate over the pan, flip the tortilla onto it, and slide it back in to cook the other side for 3 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes and cut into wedges.

name: Buckwheat galettes with ham, cheese and egg
description: Brittany-style savoury pancakes made with buckwheat flour, which is naturally gluten-free, folded around ham, cheese and a soft egg.
steps: Whisk the flour, 1 egg, salt, milk and water into a smooth, thin batter. Rest for 10 minutes if you can.
Melt a little butter in a large non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and swirl in a ladle of batter to coat the base thinly.
When the edges lift (about 2 minutes), flip the galette.
Scatter with cheese and a slice of ham, crack an egg into the middle and cover the pan for 3 minutes until the white sets.
Fold the edges in to make a square around the yolk. Season and repeat.

name: Oven-roasted ratatouille
description: Summer vegetables roasted until sweet, then folded into a garlicky tomato sauce with basil.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the aubergine, courgette, peppers and onion with 3 tbsp oil, the herbs and seasoning, and roast for 35 minutes.
Boil the potatoes for 15–20 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, soften the garlic in the remaining oil, add the tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fold the roasted veg into the sauce and tear in the basil. Serve with the potatoes.

name: Turkish eggs (çılbır)
description: Soft poached eggs on cool garlic yogurt with sizzling chilli butter and dill.
steps: Stir the garlic and a pinch of salt into the yogurt and spread it over two plates.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt the butter with the chilli flakes and paprika until it foams.
Sit the eggs on the yogurt, spoon over the chilli butter and finish with dill and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with toast.

name: Jerk chicken with rice and peas
description: Spicy, sticky roast jerk chicken thighs with coconut rice and kidney beans.
steps: Mix the jerk seasoning, juice of 1 lime, honey and oil. Coat the chicken and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and roast the chicken on a lined tray for 35–40 minutes until charred and cooked.

Meanwhile, put the rice, beans, coconut milk, water, garlic, herbs, half the spring onion and a pinch of salt in a pan. Bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes without lifting the lid.
Fluff the rice, then serve with the chicken, the rest of the spring onion and lime wedges.

name: Mango, banana and lime smoothie
description: A thick, tropical breakfast smoothie. Frozen mango works brilliantly.

ingredients.note: peeled and chopped, or 250 g frozen

steps: Put everything in a blender and blend until completely smooth.
Add a splash more juice if it's too thick, then pour into glasses.

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs gently poached in a spiced pepper and tomato sauce. Bring the pan to the table.
steps: Soften the onion and peppers in the oil in a wide frying pan for 10 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and spices for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes. Season and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Make 4 dips, crack in the eggs, cover and cook on a low heat for 6–8 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with feta and coriander and serve from the pan with bread.

name: Chickpea and apricot tagine with quinoa
description: Sweet-spiced chickpeas, sweet potato and apricots in a ras el hanout sauce, served with fluffy quinoa.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, carrots, chickpeas, tomatoes, apricots, water and crumbled stock cube. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes until the veg is tender.
Meanwhile, rinse the quinoa and simmer it in twice its volume of water for 15 minutes, then fluff it up.
Squeeze in the lemon, season, and scatter with coriander. Serve over the quinoa.
